newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDES sets CVRD sale for 1100 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDES sets CVRD sale for 1100 GMT.

text.p: In a notice published Tuesday, Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) set 0800 local/0700 EDT/1100 GMT as the official start for the auction of mining group Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD).
The notice, printed in the Gazeta Mercantil financial daily, added that the start of the sale of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares depended on all judicial barriers being overcome.
"If the judicial obstacles impeding it from taking place are over, the BNDES informs that the auction will take place May 6 after 0800 hours," the notice said.
